blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Training-free personalization adapts a frozen vision-language model (VLM) to recognize user-defined concepts from only a few exemplars by retrieving concept entries at inference time. While recent retriever-based methods enrich each concept with descriptive evidence, they largely treat concepts in isolation, so the retrieved information can be plausible yet non-discriminative, especially when the personalized concept set contains highly confusable, fine-grained categories. We argue that personalization is inherently relational: correct recognition depends on the specific distinctions between a concept and its nearest alternatives. To this end, we propose ReCoG, a Relational Concept Graph for retrieval-augmented personalization. ReCoG represents concepts as nodes and augments them with directed edges that explicitly capture discriminative cues between concept pairs, elicited by a frozen VLM during database construction. At inference, ReCoG retrieves a shortlist and resolves ambiguity via explicit pairwise comparisons conditioned on the corresponding relational edges, selecting the concept that consistently wins against competing candidates. We also introduce FINGER benchmark to test personalized recognition on confusable concept sets. Across FINGER, ReCoG substantially outperforms prior methods, with the largest gains in the most confusable regimes. ReCoG also achieves consistently best performance on established personalization benchmarks including captioning and VQA, confirming that relational evidence is broadly beneficial beyond fine-grained settings. Project Page: https://csy-98.github.io/ReCoG/
blocks.zh: 无培训的个性化通过在推论时间检索概念条目,使一个冷冻的视觉语言模型(VLM)从仅几个实例中识别用户定义的概念. 虽然最近以检索器为基础的方法用描述性证据丰富了每个概念,但它们基本上孤立地对待概念,因此检索到的信息可以令人信服,但又不具有歧视性,特别是当个性化的概念集包含高度混杂,精细的分类时. 我们认为,个性化是内在的相互关系:正确承认取决于一个概念与其最接近的备选办法之间的具体区别。 为此,我们提出ReCoG,一个可检索的个人化的关联概念图。 ReCoG代表作为节点的概念,并用直接的边缘来增强它们,明确捕捉概念对之间带有歧义的提示,在数据库构建过程中被冻结的VLM所引出. 推论,ReCoG检索了一份短名单,并通过以相应关系边缘为条件的明确对等比较解决模糊问题,选择了始终胜于竞争对手的概念。 我们还采用了FINGER基准,以测试对可互用概念集的个性化识别. 在整个FINGER中,ReCoG的成绩大大超过以前的方法,在最不相容的制度中收益最大。 ReCoG还在包括标题和VQA在内的既定个性化基准上取得一致的最佳业绩,证实关系证据在优劣环境之外广泛有益。 项目网页:https://csy-98.github.io/ReCoG/

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Personalizing vision-language model (VLM) to user-specific concepts is a central capability for interactive AI [ 9 , 17 , 1 , 19 , 8 , 11 , 36 , 7 , 24 , 22 ] .
In many applications, users want a model to recognize or generate content consistent with a set of personal concepts, such as similar-looking products, given only a few examples.
While fine-tuning can achieve high fidelity, it is often costly, slow, and difficult to repeat whenever new concepts are introduced.
blocks.zh:
将视觉语言模型(VLM)个性化为用户特有的概念是交互式AI[9,17,1,19,8,11,36,7,24,22]的中心能力.
在许多应用中,用户希望一个模型能够识别或生成与一组个人概念相符合的内容,比如类似外观的产品,仅给出了几个例子.
虽然微调可以实现高度忠诚,但每当引入新概念时,往往代价高昂、速度缓慢并难以重复。

blocks.en:
This has motivated a line of training-free personalization methods [ 11 , 8 , 29 , 15 , 26 , 16 , 14 ] .
This approach first builds a lightweight concept database, which comprises the sample images and features of the personal concepts.
Here, the features are typically visual embeddings or text descriptions obtained by VLM, by using the sample images as inputs.
At the time of inference, when a query is given, the relevant concepts are retrieved from the established concept database.
The retrieved concepts are used as input to the frozen backbone VLM.
Recent retriever-based approaches such as RAP [ 11 ] and R2P [ 8 ] have shown that this paradigm can be effective and scalable.
blocks.zh:
这促使人们采用免费培训的个性化方法[11、8、29、15、26、16、14]
这种方法首先建立了一个轻量级概念数据库,由个人概念的样本图像和特征组成.
这里,特征一般是视觉嵌入或文字描述,由VLM通过使用样本图像作为输入获得.
在推断时,当给出查询时,从已建立的概念数据库中检索出相关概念.
取回的概念被用作被冻结的主干线VLM的输入.
最近基于检索器的办法,如区域行动方案[11]和保护责任[8],表明这一范式可以有效和可扩展。

blocks.en:
However, we find that such approaches focus on representations that primarily describe each concept in isolation, i.e. , without considering the other concepts.
Even if plausible descriptions exist for each concept, they are not guaranteed to be helpful for identifying that concept with respect to other concepts in the personalized set.
As depicted in Fig. 1 , a description may capture the most salient properties of a concept, but still misses the less salient yet important cues for recognition.
These challenges become particularly severe in fine-grained regimes where concepts are highly similar.
This suggests that concept identity in personalization should be formulated relationally rather than purely unary.
What matters is not only a description, but also the distinction that makes discrimination.
blocks.zh:
然而,我们发现,这些办法侧重于主要孤立地描述每个概念的表述,即不考虑其他概念。
即使对每个概念都有可信的描述,也不能保证这些描述有助于确定概念与个性化组合中的其他概念之间的关系。
如图1所描述的,描述可能包含一个概念最显著的属性,但仍然忽略了不太突出但重要的识别提示。
在概念高度相近的完善制度中,这些挑战变得特别严重。
这表明,个性化中的概念身份应当以关系而不是纯粹的空想来表达。
重要的是不仅要描述,还要区分歧视。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Illustration of why relations matter. Left: When VLM describes each concept independently, it produces salient yet generic attributes shared across confusable concepts, leading to ambiguity. Right: When VLM is conditioned on the inter-concept relation ( e.g. , asking what differs between candidates), it can elicit discriminative cues that ease recognition even under fine-grained setting.
blocks.zh: 图1:说明关系为何重要。 左边 : 当VLM独立地描述每个概念时,它会产生在互联概念中共享的突出而通用的属性,导致模糊. 对: 当VLM以概念间关系为条件时(例如,询问候选人之间有什么区别),它会引发歧视性提示,即使在精心设定的情况下也会放松识别.

blocks.en:
In this light, we propose to consider relations among concepts for personalization more explicitly.
Training-free personalization can become more discriminative and more robust, by eliciting contrastive evidence during database construction and by performing relative comparisons among competing candidates during retrieval.
To this end, we propose Re lational Co ncept G raph ( ReCoG ), a novel training-free personalization method based on the relations among the concepts, by explicitly encoding and exploiting them.
ReCoG represents concepts as nodes and introduces directed edges that store discriminative textual information specific to a concept pair.
These edges capture the attributes and cues that are most useful for distinguishing two nearby concepts, instead of repeating generic descriptions that may be shared by multiple nodes.
blocks.zh:
有鉴于此,我们提议更明确地考虑个人化概念之间的关系。
通过在数据库构建过程中收集对比性证据,以及在检索过程中对竞争对手进行相对比较,免费培训的个人化可能变得更加具有歧视性并更加有力。
为此,我们提议通过明确编码和利用概念,在概念之间的关系基础上,采用新的免费培训个人化方法。
ReCoG代表作为节点的概念,并引入了可存储一对概念所特有的歧视性文本信息的定向边缘.
这些边缘捕捉对区分相邻两个概念最有用的属性和提示,而不是重复多个节点可能共享的通用描述.

blocks.en:
At inference time, we shift the focus from retrieving the most similar node to retrieving the most helpful distinction for disambiguation.
ReCoG performs pairwise comparisons between candidates using the relational edges associated with each pair, identifying which concept better matches the query under the relevant pair-specific distinctions.
This relational structure allows the system to select evidence that is aligned with the actual ambiguities present in the query.
blocks.zh:
在推论中,我们把重点从取回最相近的节点转移到取回最有帮助的区别来混淆.
ReCoG 使用每对对应物的相关关系边缘对候选人进行对偶比较,确定哪个概念更符合相关对偶特定区分下的查询.
这种关系结构使系统能够选择与查询中实际存在的模糊性相一致的证据.

blocks.en:
Furthermore, we introduce a FINe-Grained pERsonalization ( FINGER ) benchmark to evaluate fine-grained personalization.
First, we employ CUB-200-2011 [ 31 ] , a classic fine-grained bird dataset, and construct two regimes: CUB-Easy, formed by randomly sampling species, and CUB-Hard, formed by selecting highly similar species using CUB’s attribute annotations to intentionally maximize inter-concept confusability.
Second, we include a CLEVR-based task [ 13 ] where each concept corresponds to a scene configuration and images rendered from different viewpoints belong to the same concept, providing a controlled environment with systematically adjustable difficulty.
blocks.zh:
此外,我们引入了一个FINE-GRAINED PERsonalization(FINGER)基准来评价精细的个性化.
首先,我们使用CUB-200-2011 [31],一个经典的细纹鸟类数据集,并构建了两种制度:由随机抽样物种形成的CUB-Easy和由CUB-Hard,通过使用CUB的属性说明来选择高度相似的物种来有意地使概念间的可辨性最大化而形成的CUB-Easy.
其次,我们包括一个基于CLEVR的任务[13],其中每个概念对应一个场景配置,从不同观点得到的图像属于同一个概念,提供了具有系统可调整难度的控制环境.

blocks.en:
On FINGER benchmark, ReCoG remarkably outperforms prior approaches, demonstrating that explicitly encoding distinctions is crucial for overcoming fine-grained confusion where relation-agnostic descriptions often fail.
In addition, on conventional benchmarks [ 1 , 19 , 8 ] , ReCoG also consistently achieves best performance on all tasks (recognition, image captioning, and VQA).
This strongly confirms that ReCoG is a promising framework even under coarse-grained settings.
blocks.zh:
在FINGER基准上,ReCoG明显优于以前的做法,表明明确编码区分对于克服关系不可知描述往往失败的细微混乱至关重要。
此外,在常规基准[1、19、8]上,ReCoG还一贯在所有任务(识别、图像字幕和VQA)上取得最佳业绩。
这有力地证实了ReCoG即使在粗糙的环境下也是一个很有希望的框架.

blocks.en: 2 Related Works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工程

blocks.en: 2.1 Personalization on VLMs and MLLMs
blocks.zh: 2.1 脆弱母亲和产妇的个性化

blocks.en:
Recent vision-language models (VLMs) and multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have shown strong capabilities in various multimodal tasks [ 35 , 12 , 2 , 6 , 10 ] .
However, their knowledge is mostly generic.
They can recognize common categories such as “dog”, but they do not naturally recognize user-specific instances such as “user’s own dog".
Personalization of VLMs/MLLMs aims to incorporate user-provided concepts into downstream responses.
Existing work has studied how frozen VLM representations can be extended to such concepts through learned embeddings, concept-specific modules, or lightweight alignment mechanisms [ 7 , 1 , 19 , 22 , 21 ] .
Recent work further expands this direction from single-concept image personalization to multi-concept or online settings [ 3 , 4 , 34 , 20 , 5 ] and video applications [ 30 , 37 ] .
Despite their effectiveness, many of these approaches require additional optimization or auxiliary modules, which can limit scalability.
blocks.zh:
近期的视觉语言模型(VLMs)和多模式大语言模型(MLLMs)在各种多模式任务中表现出了强大的能力[35,12,2,6,10].
然而,他们的知识大多是一般性的。
他们可以识别诸如"狗"等常见的类别,但他们自然不会识别"用户自有的狗"等用户特有的情况.
将VLMs/MLLMs的个性化旨在将用户提供的概念纳入下游反应中。
现有工作研究了如何通过所学到的嵌入、具体概念的模块或轻量级对接机制[7, 1, 19, 22, 21]将被冻结的VLM表示扩展至这些概念.
最近的工作进一步扩大了这一方向,从单一概念的图像个性化到多概念或在线设置[3,4,34,20,5]和视频应用[30,37].
尽管这些方法很有效,但其中许多方法需要额外的优化或辅助模块,这可以限制可扩展性。

blocks.en: 2.2 Training-Free Personalization
blocks.zh: 2.2 免费培训

blocks.en:
Training-free personalization avoids updating model parameters for each new user or concept.
RAP [ 11 ] proposes a retrieval-augmented framework for MLLM personalization based on retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) [ 17 , 9 ] .
It stores user-specific concepts as a form of database, retrieves relevant concepts with a multimodal retriever, and injects the retrieved concept information into the MLLM input to generate personalized responses.
R2P [ 8 ] further extracts descriptive texts for personalized concepts and compares retrieved candidate concepts via Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning [ 32 ] .
Recent training-free systems similarly build external or lightweight personal memories by storing descriptive textual metadata, visual prompts, or concept-representative visual tokens [ 27 , 33 , 28 ] .
However, these methods primarily represent concepts independently using descriptive evidence.
In contrast, ReCoG focuses on relations among personalized concepts, enabling VLM to perform more effective reasoning and discrimination of user-specific concepts.
blocks.zh:
免费培训的个性化可避免更新每个新用户或概念的模型参数.
区域行动方案[11]根据检索-增强生成(RAG)[17、9],为MLLM个人化提出了一个检索-增强框架。
它存储用户特有的概念作为数据库的一种形式,用多模式检索器检索出相关概念,并将被检索出的概念信息注入MLLM输入器以生成个性化的响应.
R2P[8]进一步取出个性化概念的描述性案文,并通过Cain-of-Thought(CoT)推理来比较检索到的候选概念[32].
最近的无培训系统同样通过存储描述性文字元数据、可视提示或概念代表性可视符号[27、33、28]来建立外部或轻量级的个人记忆。
然而,这些方法主要代表独立使用描述性证据的概念。
相形之下,ReCoG注重个性化概念之间的关系,使VLM能够对用户特定概念进行更有效的推理和歧视.

blocks.en: 2.3 Personalization Benchmarks
blocks.zh: 2.3 个性化基准

blocks.en:
Early benchmarks focus on whether models can learn and use user-specific concepts for personalized tasks [ 7 , 1 , 19 , 22 ] .
Subsequent works extend it to compositional settings, including chimeric concept-context composition and multi-concept interactions [ 25 , 8 , 3 ] .
More recent benchmarks further improve realism and scale by covering diverse modalities and concept types [ 27 , 5 , 4 ] .
Despite these contributions, benchmarks with carefully controlled fine-grained distinctions among personalized concepts remain limited.
For example, Yo’LLaVA++ introduced in Jarvis [ 33 ] targets fine-grained recognition, but it is limited to text modality.
Since distinguishing subtle differences among user-specific visual concepts is crucial for VLM personalization, we introduce FINGER, a novel benchmark designed to evaluate fine-grained personalization across varying levels of difficulty.
blocks.zh:
早期的基准侧重于模型是否能够为个性化的任务学习和使用用户特有的概念[7, 1, 19, 22].
之后的作品将其扩展至组成环境,包括奇美概念-文本组成和多概念相互作用[25,8,3].
较近期的基准通过涵盖多种模式和概念类型[27、5、4],进一步改善现实性和规模。
尽管作出了这些贡献,但对个人化概念加以细微区分的基准仍然有限。
例如,在Jarvis[33]中引入了Yo'LLAVA++,目标精细的识别,但仅限于文本模式.
由于区分用户特定视觉概念之间的细微差异对于VLM个性化至关重要,因此我们引入了FINGER这个新基准,旨在评价不同程度的困难中细微的个性化.

为了使被冻结的VLM能够处理新概念,我们遵循以前作品中通常采用的两阶段模式:

blocks.en: 3.2 Conventional Relation-Agnostic Approaches
blocks.zh: 3.2 常规关系不可知办法

blocks.en:
To the best of our knowledge, existing retrieval-based personalization methods construct the database 𝒮 \mathcal{S} without considering relations among concepts.
We refer to these approaches as “Relation-Agnostic”.
In such methods, each concept is represented independently by a standalone entry.
We review representative relation-agnostic instantiations under the formulation in Sec. 3.1 .

blocks.en: 4 Methods
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en: 4.1 Importance of Relation Among Concepts in Personalization
blocks.zh: 4.1 概念之间的关系在个性化中的重要性

blocks.en:
As discussed above, prior works have focused on improving the descriptiveness of per-concept representations (by using CLIP embeddings or augmenting them with VLM-generated textual attributes).
However, being descriptive and being discriminative are not always aligned.
Even if plausible descriptions exist for each concept, they are not guaranteed to be discriminative with respect to other concepts in the personalized set.
A description may capture most salient properties of a concept while still missing the few attributes that distinguish it from its closest alternatives.
blocks.zh:
如上所讨论,先前的作品侧重于改进每个概念表达的描述性(通过使用CLIP嵌入或用由VLM生成的文字属性来扩充它们).
然而,描述性和歧视性并不总是一致的。
即使对每个概念都有可信的描述,也不能保证这些描述对个性化组合中的其他概念具有歧视性。
描述可以捕捉一个概念最显著的属性,同时仍然缺少一些区分它与它最接近的替代物的属性.

For each ordered pair ( c i , c j ) (c_{i},c_{j}) , the VLM summarizes what makes c i c_{i} different from c j c_{j} , producing an edge e i ​ j e_{ij} (and vice versa). Collecting these directed edges yields the Relational Concept Graph , which provides explicit inter-concept relations.

blocks.en:
In fine-grained regimes, i.e. , when the concepts to be personalized are highly similar to one another, this issue becomes particularly severe.
For example, in CUB , many bird species share highly similar global appearances ( e.g. , “a dark bird with a streaked breast”).
Descriptive approaches can easily focus on the most salient attributes that characterize each species in isolation, while overlooking subtle yet crucial cues that separate visually confusable species ( e.g. , slight differences in head markings, wing-bar patterns, or bill shape).
In short, within the context of personalization, information extracted independently per concept can be descriptive yet insufficient to ensure strong separability.
blocks.zh:
在精细的制度中,即当拟个性化的概念彼此高度相近时,这个问题变得特别严重.
例如,在CUB中,许多鸟类具有高度相似的全球外观(例如,“一头乳房垂缩的黑鸟”)。
描述性方法可以很容易地聚焦于每个物种在孤立状态下的特点最突出的属性,而忽略了将可视相容物种分开的微妙而关键的提示(例如,头部标记、翼管图案或帐单形状略有差异)。
简言之,在个性化的背景下,每个概念独立提取的信息可能只是描述性的,但不足以确保强烈的分离性。

blocks.en:
A similar limitation also appears in the retrieval phase.
Most existing methods assess, for each concept independently, how likely the query belongs to that concept, and then select the concept with the highest score.
However, this strategy implicitly assumes that the resulting scores are well-calibrated and comparable across concepts.
In practice, both CLIP similarities and VLM-based verification scores can be sensitive to prompt phrasing, visual context, and concept-specific ambiguities, making their absolute scale unreliable for global ranking.
Consequently, choosing the maximum among independently computed confidences can be brittle, especially under fine-grained situation.
blocks.zh:
在检索阶段也出现了类似的限制。
多数现有方法独立评估每个概念的查询是否属于该概念,然后选择得分最高的概念.
然而,这一战略隐含地假定,由此产生的分数是经过适当校准的,并且可以在不同概念之间进行比较。
在实践中,CLIP的相似性和基于VLM的验证分数都对即时措辞,视觉上下文,以及概念上的模糊性很敏感,因此其绝对分数对于全球排名是不可靠的.
因此,在独立计算的信任中选择最大信任可能十分脆弱,特别是在精心计算的情况下。

blocks.en:
We argue that both limitations stem from ignoring relations among concepts .
If database construction and retrieval are explicitly conditioned on inter-concept relations— e.g. , by eliciting contrastive evidence during description generation and by performing relative comparisons among competing candidates during retrieval—personalization can become more discriminative and more robust.
Motivated by this insight, we propose Relational Concept Graph ( ReCoG ), which incorporates concept relations as an important signal throughout both database construction and retrieval.
blocks.zh:
我们争辩说,这两种限制都源于忽视概念之间的关系。
如果数据库的构建和检索明确以概念间关系为条件,例如,在生成描述时引出对比性证据,在检索时对竞争对手进行相对比较,那么个性化就可能更加具有歧视性和更有力。
基于这种见解,我们提出了关系概念图(ReCoG),将概念关系作为数据库构建和检索过程中的一个重要信号。

At inference time, sparse construction may leave some candidate pairs without precomputed relational edges.
There are two possible ways to handle such missing edges.
The first option is to generate the missing edge on demand using the same discriminative prompt as in database construction.
This preserves the full pairwise comparison behavior for the encountered pair, at the cost of an additional inference-time VLM call; once generated, the edge can also be cached into the database for future use.
The second option is to avoid any additional VLM call and treat the missing comparison as a tie, assigning no win to either candidate.
This may introduce a small performance drop because some pairwise comparisons are skipped during round-robin, but it keeps inference strictly within the precomputed sparse graph.
In our experiments (Sec. 6.6 ), we find that this simple no-call strategy already provides a favorable trade-off between computational cost and recognition accuracy.
blocks.zh:
在推论中,零星的构造可能使一些候选配对没有预想的关系边缘.
处理这种缺失边缘有两种可能的方法.
第一个选择是使用与数据库建设相同的歧视性提示,按需生成缺失边缘.
这保存了被遇到对对的完整的对比行为,代价是额外的推论时间VLM调用;一旦生成,边缘也可以被缓存到数据库中供将来使用.
第二种选择是避免任何额外的VLM呼叫,并将缺失的比较作为平分处理,给两个候选人都判无胜负.
这可能会引入一个小的性能下降,因为一些双向比较在回旋周期被跳过,但它严格地将推论维持在预算的稀有图中.
在我们的实验中(第6.6节),我们发现这种简单的不打电话策略已经在计算成本和识别准确性之间提供了有利的取舍。

blocks.en: 5 FINGER Benchmark
blocks.zh: 5 FINGER 基准

blocks.en:
In practical personalization scenarios, the challenge is often fine-grained: users may want an AI system to distinguish between highly similar concepts that differ only in subtle visual details ( e.g. , closely related species or visually similar parts in manufacturing).
Motivated by this, we introduce a FINe-Grained pERsonalization (FINGER) Benchmark that explicitly targets concept sets with high visual confusability, as in Fig. 3 .
blocks.zh:
在实用的个性化场景中,挑战往往是细微的:用户可能希望AI系统区分出仅在细微的视觉细节(如制造业中紧密相通的物种或视觉相近部分)上存在差异的高度相近的概念.
以此为动机,我们引入了FINE-GRAINED PERsonalization(FINGER) 如图3所示,明确针对视觉模糊度高的概念的基准。

blocks.en: Figure 3: The proposed FINGER Benchmark. Left : 20 concepts in CUB-Easy (top) and CUB-Hard (bottom). We also provide the pairwise concept similarity matrices computed from CUB’s visual attribute vectors (darker means higher similarity, i.e. , more difficult). Right : 20 concepts in CLEVR, where each concept corresponds to a specific scene configuration.
blocks.zh: 图3:拟议的FINGER基准。 左: CUB-Easy(上)和CUB-Hard(下)的20个概念. 我们还提供从 CUB 的视觉属性向量( darker 表示更高的相似性, 即更难) 所计算的对等概念相似性矩阵 。 右: CLEVR中的20个概念,其中每个概念对应特定的场景配置.

blocks.en:
The first task is based on CUB-200-2011 dataset [ 31 ] , which contains 200 bird species with subtle inter-class variations.
A useful property of CUB is that each image has a vector of semantic visual attributes ( e.g. , body color), enabling controlled construction of challenging concept sets.
Using CUB, we build two tasks with different levels of difficulty.
Each task contains N = 20 N=20 concepts; for each concept, we provide one support image and nineteen query images, resulting in 400 images per task.
blocks.zh:
第一项任务基于CUB-200-2011数据集[31],包含有200个鸟类物种,具有细微的等级间差异.
CUB的一个有用的属性是,每个图像都有语义视觉属性的向量(例如:体色),能够控制地构建有挑战性的概念集.
使用CUB,我们构建两个难度不同的任务.
每个任务包含N=20个N=20个概念;对于每个概念,我们提供1个支持图像和19个查询图像,结果每个任务有400个图像.

blocks.en:
We construct CUB-Easy task by sampling 20 species at random from the 200 classes.
We therefore refer to this task as “Easy,” although it remains challenging.
In contrast, CUB-Hard task is intentionally designed to be more confusable.
Specifically, we select visually similar concepts by leveraging CUB attributes, for example by focusing on species that score highly along attributes related to black appearance.
CUB-Hard matches CUB-Easy in configuration, but is considerably more difficult: the system must retrieve the correct concept from a set of visually similar, predominantly black birds given a query that is itself a black bird.
blocks.zh:
我们通过从200个类别中随机取样20个物种来构建CUB-Easy任务.
因此,我们把这项任务称为“轻松”,尽管它仍然具有挑战性。
相形之下,CUB-Hard任务被有意设计为更相容.
具体来说,我们通过利用 CUB 属性来选择视觉上相似的概念,比如通过关注在与黑色外观相关的属性上得分很高的物种.
CUB-Hard在配置上与CUB-Easy相匹配,但难度要大得多:系统必须从一组视觉相近,以黑鸟为主的鸟类中取回正确的概念,给一个本身是黑鸟的查询.

blocks.en:
We also introduce a CLEVR -based task to provide a more controlled environment [ 13 ] .
CLEVR framework supports compositional scene generation with objects of different shapes, colors, sizes, and materials.
We treat an entire scene configuration ( i.e. , a set of objects and their spatial arrangement) as a concept, and regard images rendered from different viewpoints as belonging to that concept.
For this task, we use 20 concepts with 1 support image and 9 query images per concept (200 images total).
This benchmark is particularly useful because its difficulty can be systematically adjusted by controlling the degree of overlap in scene attributes.
More details are provided in Appendix (Sec. A ).
blocks.zh:
我们还提出了基于CLEVR的任务,以提供一个更受控制的环境[13].
CLEVR框架支持由不同形状,颜色,大小和材料的物体组成场景生成.
我们把整个场景配置(即一组物体及其空间安排)视为一个概念,并将不同观点提供的图像视为属于这一概念。
对于这项任务,我们使用20个概念,每个概念有1个支持图像和9个查询图像(共计200个图像).
这个基准特别有用,因为它的难度可以通过控制场景属性的重叠程度来系统调整.
详情见附录(A节)。

blocks.en: 6 Experimental Results
blocks.zh: 6 实验结果

blocks.en: 6.1 Setup
blocks.zh: 6.1 设置

blocks.en:
Datasets/Metrics. In addition to our FINGER benchmark, we evaluate ReCoG on three established benchmarks: MyVLM (29 concepts) [ 1 ] , Yo’LLaVA (40 concepts) [ 19 ] , and PerVA (329 concepts) [ 8 ] .
For recognition task, we report positive accuracy (P.Acc.), measured on positive queries that include the target concept, and negative accuracy (N.Acc.), measured on negative queries that exclude the target concept. As same as R2P [ 8 ] , for each target concept, we exhaustively evaluates images from all other concepts as negative examples. However, we measured the negative accuracy of the Baseline and ReCoG from their top-1 retrieval results, as the goal was to evaluate the output of the personalization retriever. Wtd. denotes the uniformly weighted average of them: (P.Acc.+N.Acc.)/2.
For captioning and VQA tasks, we report hard recall and accuracy, respectively, following R2P [ 8 ] .
blocks.zh:
数据集/计量. 除了FINGER基准外,我们还根据三个既定基准评价ReCoG:MyVLM(29个概念)[1],Yo-LlaVA(40个概念)[19],和PerVA(329个概念)[8]。
对于识别任务,我们报告正准确性(P.Acc.),以包含目标概念的正询问来测量,而负准确性(N.Acc.),以排除目标概念的负询问来测量. 与R2P[8]一样,对于每个目标概念,我们详尽地评价所有其他概念的图像为负面例子。 然而,我们从基准和ReCoG的顶级-1检索结果中测出其负准确性,因为目标是评价个性化检索器的输出. Wtd.表示它们的统一加权平均值:(P.Acc.+N.Acc.) 2.
关于标题和VQA任务,我们分别按照R2P[8]报告硬召回和准确性。

blocks.en:
Implementation. We construct the database using CLIP [ 23 ] ViT-L.
We use MiniCPM-o-2.6 [ 35 ] as VLM by default.
Results with LLaVA [ 18 ] are in Appendix (Sec. E ).
Similar to R2P [ 8 ] , we construct database using a single reference image per concept, without negative samples.
Although this setting is more challenging, it better matches real-world personalization with minimal user effort.
blocks.zh:
执行。 我们用CLIP[23]Vit-L构建数据库.
我们默认使用MiniCPM-o-2.6[35]作为VLM.
LLaVA[18]的结果载于附录(E节)。
与R2P[8]类似,我们使用每个概念的单一参考图像构建数据库,没有负样本.
虽然这种设置更具有挑战性,但它更能匹配现实世界的个性化,同时尽量减少用户的努力.

blocks.en: 6.2 Results on FINGER Benchmark
blocks.zh: 6.2 FINGER基准结果

blocks.en:
Table 1 reports the results on our FINGER Benchmark, and it cleanly illustrates why relational understanding is the key component in training-free personalization. ReCoG dominates across all tasks and metrics .
On Wtd., ReCoG achieves 98.1% on CUB-Easy, 92.8% on CUB-Hard, and 93.3% on CLEVR, outperforming the strongest prior work R2P [ 8 ] by +9.7, +11.8, and +13.7 percent points, respectively.
The gains are even larger on P.Acc.
This is notable because our benchmark comprising highly confusable concepts, yet ReCoG still maintains substantial performance.
blocks.zh:
表1按 " FINGER基准 " 汇报了结果,并清楚说明了为什么关系理解是无培训个人化的关键组成部分。 ReCoG主导所有任务和衡量标准。
在Wtd.上,ReCoG在CUB-Easy上达到98.1%,CUB-Hard上达到92.8%,CLEVR上达到93.3%,分别以+9.7分,+11.8分和+13.7%的成绩优于前作最强的R2P [8]分.
P. Acc上的收益更大。
这一点值得注意,因为我们的基准包含高度可信任的概念,然而,ReCoG仍然保持实质性的绩效。

blocks.en:
These results also highlight how the conventional relation-agnostic personalization approach struggles with fine-grained confusion.
R2P [ 8 ] is a substantially strong method that performs well on conventional benchmarks (refer to Table 3 ).
On FINGER benchmark, however, it faces difficulty due to the visually confusing concepts ( e.g. , 63.8% P.Acc. on CUB-Hard and 61.1% P.Acc. on CLEVR).
This behavior is consistent with our motivation: concept descriptions generated in isolation are often plausible but fail to identify the specific distinctions needed to separate a concept from its closest confounders.
blocks.zh:
这些结果还突出了传统关系不可知的个性化方法如何与细微的混淆相抗衡.
保护责任[8]是一种非常有力的方法,在常规基准方面表现良好(见表3)。
然而,在FINGER基准上,由于视觉上令人困惑的概念(例如CUB-Hard的63.8%P.Acc.和CLEVR的61.1%P.Acc.),它面临着困难.
这种行为与我们的动机是一致的:孤立产生的概念描述往往是可信的,但未能确定将一个概念与其最接近的混淆者区分出来所需的具体区别.

blocks.en:
Finally, the comparison between R2P [ 8 ] and Baseline isolates the role of retrieval strategy. Our Baseline uses the same descriptive features as R2P [ 8 ] but replaces separated verification with comparison-based retrieval.
If pairwise retrieval alone were the main source of gain, we would expect a meaningful improvement over R2P [ 8 ] instead, Baseline is worse.
This implies that pairwise comparison is not always beneficial when the evidence is not aligned with the real ambiguity.
blocks.zh:
最后,R2P[8]和Basinum之间的比较孤立了检索策略的作用. 我们的基线使用与R2P[8]相同的描述特征,但用比较式检索取代了分离的核查.
如果双向检索是主要收益来源,我们期望比R2P[8]有有意义的改进,而基线则更糟。
这意味着当证据与真正的模糊性不一致时,双向比较并不总是有好处。

blocks.en:
Fig. 4 shows ReCoG’s superiority intuitively. The left confusion matrix corresponds to Baseline, and the right matrix corresponds to ReCoG.
The baseline exhibits substantial off-diagonal mass. This pattern is consistent with the nature of CUB-Hard, where concepts share very similar global appearance.
In contrast, ReCoG produces a near-diagonal structure, indicating that ReCoG consistently reduces confusion across the entire fine-grained concept set.
More qualitative results of ReCoG on FINGER benchmark can be found in Appendix (Sec. G ).
blocks.zh:
图片4直观地显示了ReCoG的优越性. 左混淆矩阵对应基线,右矩阵对应ReCoG.
基线显示大量离对角质量。 这种模式符合CUB-Hard的性质,其中的概念具有非常相似的全球外观.
相形之下,ReCoG生成了近对角结构,表明ReCoG持续地减少整个细纹概念集的混淆.
有关FINGER基准的ReCoG更高质量的结果可参见附录(Sec.G.)。

blocks.en:
Table 2 further provides a controlled analysis of CLEVR difficulty.
Here, K K denotes scene complexity and hop represets distance between the concepts (i.e., 1-hop is more fine-grained).
For more details, please refer to Appendix (Sec. A ).
As K K increases, all methods generally suffer a drop in positive accuracy, indicating that larger scenes introduce more distractors and make personalized matching harder.
Nevertheless, ReCoG consistently outperforms R2P and the Baseline.
The margin is especially pronounced in the more confusable 1-hop regime, where concepts differ only by a small local change.
Even in the relatively easier 2-hop setting, ReCoG maintains a clear advantage, reaching 81.4% compared with 68.4% for R2P [ 8 ] and 40.0% for the Baseline.
blocks.zh:
表2还提供了CLEVR难度的控制分析.
这里,KK表示场景复杂度和hop重排概念之间的距离(即1-hop更精细).
详见附录(Sec.A.)。
随着K K 的增加,所有方法的正准确度普遍会下降,这表明更大的场景会引入更多的分心器并让个性化匹配变得更加困难.
尽管如此,ReCoG的业绩始终高于保护责任和基线。
差值在比较相容的1-hop制度中特别明显,其中的概念只因局部小的改变而不同.
即使在相对容易的双跳设置中,ReCoG保持了明显的优势,达到81.4%,而R2P[8]和基线分别为68.4%和40.0%.

blocks.en: 6.3 Results on Conventional Personalization Benchmarks
blocks.zh: 6.3 常规个性化基准的结果

blocks.en:
Table 3 reports results on three established benchmarks (MyVLM [ 1 ] , Yo’LLaVA [ 19 ] , and PerVA [ 8 ] ), comparing ReCoG against both training-based [ 1 , 19 ] and training-free [ 11 , 8 ] approaches.
ReCoG achieves the best performance across all tasks (recognition, captioning, and VQA) and all benchmarks, consistently outperforming prior methods under the same evaluation protocol.
The results indicate that the relational evidence encoded by ReCoG is not only beneficial in our challenging FINGER benchmark, but also transfers to conventional personalization scenarios where concepts are less confusable, yielding substantial performance even on the relatively saturated benchmarks.
blocks.zh:
表3报告了三个既定基准(MyVLM [1]、Yo-LLAVA [19]和PerVA [8])的结果,比较了RECoG与基于培训的[1、19]和无培训的[11、8]方法。
ReCoG在所有任务(识别、标题和VQA)和所有基准方面都取得了最佳业绩,一直比同一评价协议下的以往方法表现好。
结果表明,ReCoG编码的关联证据不仅有利于我们具有挑战性的FINGER基准,也有利于向传统个性化假设的转移,因为概念不易相通,即使在相对饱和的基准上也会产生实质性的性能.

blocks.en: 6.4 Analysis on Sparse ReCoG
blocks.zh: 6.4 关于Sparse ReCoG的分析

blocks.en:
We evaluate sparse ReCoG on CUB-Hard to analyze the trade-off between database construction cost and recognition accuracy.
In this experiment, we use the tie strategy in Sec. 4.4 : if a candidate pair does not have precomputed relational edges, the comparison is treated as a tie during round-robin aggregation.
Alternatively, if additional inference-time VLM calls are acceptable occasionally, missing edges can be constructed online. This yields the same behavior as full ReCoG.
blocks.zh:
我们评价CUB -Hard上的微弱的ReCoG 分析数据库建设成本和识别准确度之间的权衡。
在这个实验中,我们使用第4.4节中的平局策略:如果一个候选对子没有预计算出的关系边缘,则比较在圆旋聚合时作为平局处理.
或者,如果偶尔可以接受额外的推论时间VLM呼叫,则可以在线构建缺失的边缘. 这产生与全ReCoG相同的行为.

blocks.en:
As shown in Fig. 5 , increasing k k rapidly improves performance with only a small number of additional VLM calls.
Even with k = 1 k=1 , Sparse ReCoG already outperforms R2P [ 8 ] while requiring only 13 VLM calls for graph construction.
More notably, with k = 2 k=2 , it reaches 85.0% P.Acc. using only 26 VLM calls, which is close to the full ReCoG performance of 86.3% obtained with all 190 pairwise edges.
After this point, the performance largely saturates, suggesting that most useful relational evidence comes from a small set of visually similar neighboring concepts.
These results indicate that sparse ReCoG could provide a practical cost-accuracy trade-off.
blocks.zh:
如图5所示,增加kk能快速地提高性能,仅多出少量额外的VLM呼叫.
即使用 k = 1 k = 1, Sparse ReCoG 也已经超过 R2P [8], 而只需要 13 VLM 调用图构建 .
更值得注意的是,用克=2克=2,它只使用26个VLM调用就达到了85.0%的P.Acc.,这接近所有190个双相边得到的86.3%的完全ReCoG性能.
这一点之后,性能基本是饱和的,这表明最有用的关系证据来自一小组视觉相近的概念.
这些结果表明,很少的ReCoG可以提供实际的成本准确性取舍。

blocks.en: 6.5 Isolating Relational Evidence from Pairwise Retrieval
blocks.zh: 6.5 从对等检索中分离关系证据

blocks.en: Table 4 reports an ablation study on relational edge evidence and candidate scoring to isolate the effects of relational reasoning from the pairwise search approach. ReCoG consists of two distinct components: (i) relational evidence construction and (ii) pairwise retrieval. We therefore organize the ablation on CUB-Hard along two axes to distinguish their respective contributions:
blocks.zh: 表4报告了一项关于关系边缘证据和候选人评分的分数研究,将关系推理的效果与双向搜索方法隔离开来。 ReCoG由两个不同的部分组成:(一) 关系证据构建和(二) 双向检索。 因此,我们沿着两个轴线组织关于CUB-Hard的大会,以区分其各自的贡献:

blocks.en: Table 4: Ablation study on different evidence types and scoring procedures on CUB-Hard.
blocks.zh: 表4:关于CUB-Hard不同证据类型和评分程序的研究。

blocks.en:
Method 1 is R2P [ 8 ] . It independently constructs a description for each concept and verifies each retrieved candidate separately. Method 4 is our ReCoG, which constructs pair-specific relational evidence and uses it during pairwise comparison and round-robin aggregation. To further isolate the contribution of each component—relational evidence and pairwise scoring—we additionally evaluate Methods 2 and 3. Method 2 is the Baseline, which uses the same concept-wise descriptions as R2P [ 8 ] but replaces candidate-wise verification with the pairwise retrieval procedure used by ReCoG.
Finally, Method 3 is the requested relational-evidence variant with candidate-wise scoring. For each candidate, we aggregate the descriptions directed toward that candidate from all relational edges involving the other retrieved candidates. We then independently evaluate each candidate using the query image, its support image, and its aggregated relational evidence, following the candidate-wise verification procedure of R2P [ 8 ] . The candidate with the highest “Yes” confidence is selected.
blocks.zh:
方法1为R2P [8]. 它独立地为每个概念构建一个说明,并分别核查每个被检索的候选人。 方法4就是我们的ReCoG,它构建出对偶特异性的关系证据,并在对偶比较和圆圈聚合时使用. 为了进一步分离每个组成部分的贡献——关系证据和对等评分——我们进一步评价方法2和3。 方法2是"基线",它使用与R2P[8]相同的概念式描述,但以ReCoG使用的对等回取程序来取代候选的对等验证.
最后,方法3是所要求的关系证据变体,与候选人的得分一致。 对于每个候选人,我们从涉及其他被检索候选人的各种关系方面汇总了针对该候选人的描述。 然后,我们按照R2P [8] 的候选核查程序,利用查询图像、其支持图像及其汇总的关系证据,独立评估每个候选人。 选出“是”信心最高的候选人。

blocks.en: Method 3 improves P.Acc. from 63.8% to 74.0%, showing that contrastively generated relational evidence is more informative than independently generated concept descriptions. However, it remains 12.3 percentage points below ReCoG. These results demonstrate that contrastively generated relational evidence is an important source of improvement, but is not sufficient to explain the full performance of ReCoG. They also show that pairwise retrieval becomes substantially more effective when it is conditioned on pair-specific relational evidence.
blocks.zh: 方法3改进了P.Acc.,从63.8%提高到74.0%,显示对比性生成的关系证据比独立生成的概念描述更加翔实. 然而,它仍然比ReCoG低12.3%。 这些结果表明,相对产生的关系证据是一个重要的改进来源,但不足以解释ReCoG的全面性能. 它们还表明,如果对偶检索以对偶特定关系证据为条件,则对偶检索将大大提高效力。

blocks.en: 6.6 Scalability to Large and Dynamic Concept Libraries
blocks.zh: 6.6 大型动态概念图书馆的可扩展性

blocks.en:
To directly analyze the scalability of ReCoG, we conducted an additional large-scale experiment using all 200 species in CUB, treating each species as a distinct personalized concept.
For the missing edges in Sparse ReCoG, we consider two strategies. In the tie strategy, a candidate pair without a precomputed relation edge is treated as a tie. Consequently, Sparse ReCoG may perform fewer than pairwise comparisons. For example, the tie strategy requires an average of 2.46 VLM calls per query (2.79 s), compared with 3 calls for R2P [ 8 ] (3.83 s).
In the on-demand strategy, a missing relation is generated when the corresponding candidate pair is encountered for the first time and is then cached for all subsequent queries. Under our default setting of , this requires at most three additional calls. However, the same pair never requires another construction call once its relation has been cached. In our 200-concept experiment, the on-demand strategy requires an average of 3.281 VLM calls per query (3.86 s) during the first evaluation pass, and this decreases to 3 calls per query after caching.
Even with and the no-call tie strategy, Sparse ReCoG (56.2%) outperforms R2P [ 8 ] (48.6%) in P.Acc., while requiring fewer VLM calls in both offline database construction and online inference.
blocks.zh:
为了直接分析ReCoG的可扩展性,我们利用CUB的所有200个物种进行了额外的大规模实验,将每个物种视为一个独特的个性化概念.
对于Sparse ReCoG中缺失的边缘,我们考虑两种策略. 在平分策略中,一个没有预估关系边缘的候选人对被视作平分. 因此,Sparse ReCoG的比对可能少于对比。 例如,平分策略要求每个查询平均2.46个VLM呼叫(2.79 s),而3个R2P[8](3.83 s)的呼叫.
在点播策略中,当首次遇到对应的候选对并随后被缓存到所有后续查询时,会生成缺失关系. 在我们的默认设置下,这需要最多增加三个电话。 然而,一旦它的关系被缓存,同一对就再也不需要再发出构建呼叫. 在我们的200概念实验中,点播策略要求在第一次评价通关时平均每个查询(3.86 s)需要3.281个VLM呼叫,这在缓存后减少到每个查询3个.
Sparse ReCoG(56.2%)在P.Acc.中甚至超过了R2P[8](48.6%),同时在离线数据库建设和在线推论中要求减少VLM的呼叫。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
We presented ReCoG, a training-free personalization framework that explicitly models relations among user-defined concepts.
ReCoG constructs a Relational Concept Graph whose directed edges encode pair-specific discriminative evidence.
At inference time, ReCoG leverages these relational edges to perform explicit pairwise comparisons among retrieved candidates.
We further introduced FINGER, a benchmark designed to evaluate personalized recognition under controlled fine-grained difficulty.
Extensive experiments show that ReCoG substantially improves over prior training-free personalization methods on FINGER, especially in the most confusable regimes.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了 " ReCoG " 方案,这是一个免费培训的个人化框架,明确模拟用户定义的概念之间的关系。
ReCoG 构建一个关系概念图,其直接边缘编码成对特定的歧视证据.
在推论时间,ReCoG利用这些关系边缘在被检索的候选人中进行明确的对等比较.
我们进一步引入了FINGER,这个基准旨在评价在受控的精细困难下的个人化识别.
广泛的实验表明,ReCoG在FINGER上大大改进了以往的免费培训个人化方法,特别是在最不相容的制度中。

blocks.en:
Limitation. Although sparse ReCoG shows that the construction cost can be substantially reduced while maintaining strong performance, scalability may still become challenging when the number of concepts grows significantly or when the database is updated online.
Developing more adaptive and efficient graph sparsification strategies is therefore an interesting direction for future work.
blocks.zh:
限制。 虽然稀少的ReCoG显示,建筑成本可以在保持强性能的同时被大幅降低,但当概念数量显著增加或数据库在线更新时,可扩展性仍会变得具有挑战性.
因此,制定更适应性更强、更有效率的图溅战略是今后工作的一个令人感兴趣的方向。

blocks.en: Appendix A Additional Details and Experiments on CLEVR
blocks.zh: 附录A 关于CLEVR的补充细节和实验

blocks.en:
We construct a FINGER benchmark using a CLEVR-based pipeline.
Scene rendering is implemented with custom scripts built on top of the original CLEVR utilities, using a fixed base scene and predefined object/material dictionaries.
Each concept is defined over object-level attributes from a controlled vocabulary, including shape (cube, sphere, cylinder), color (8 values), material (rubber, metal), and size (small, large).
blocks.zh:
我们使用基于CLEVR的管道构建了FINGER基准.
场景渲染由自定义的脚本来实施,这些脚本被建在原来的CLEVR公用设施上,使用固定的基场和预定义的对象/材料词典.
每个概念在对象级属性之上由受控词汇定义,包括形状(立方体,球体,圆柱),颜色(8个值),材料(橡胶,金属)和大小(小,大).

blocks.en: A.1 CLEVR-Default in the Main Paper
blocks.zh: A.1 主文件中的CLEVR-过失

blocks.en:
For the CLEVR-Default experiments in the main paper, we construct the concepts by generating 20 concepts organized as a chain-like procedure.
Here, each concept is derived from the previous one by changing the attributes of one or two objects, while keeping the overall scene layout highly similar across adjacent concepts.
In the benchmark used in the main paper, these edits are restricted to shape, color, and material changes, while object size and object positions are kept unchanged across neighboring concepts.
Each concept corresponds to a fixed object configuration and is rendered into 10 multi-view images, yielding 200 images in total.
For evaluation, we use one image per concept as the support example and the remaining nine as query images.
blocks.zh:
对于主论文中的CLEVR-default实验,我们通过生成20个作为类似链式程序组织的概念来构建概念.
在这里,每个概念都是通过改变一到两个对象的属性而从上一个概念中衍生出来的,同时在相邻概念中保持整体场景布局高度相近.
在正文中使用的基准中,这些编辑被限制在形状,颜色和材料上的变化,而对象大小和对象位置则在相邻的概念之间保持不变.
每个概念对应一个固定对象配置,并被制成10个多视图图像,总共产生200个图像.
对于评价,我们使用每个概念的一个图像作为支持例子,其余九个作为查询图像。

blocks.en:
Table A5 lists the actual scene-to-scene edits for one instantiation of this benchmark (denoted as CLEVR).
The table makes the chain construction explicit: each transition from scene t t to scene t + 1 t+1 is realized by one or two local attribute edits on individual objects.
Most transitions involve a single modification, such as changing the color of object 2 from blue to green (scene00 → \rightarrow scene01) or the material of object 3 from metal to rubber (scene01 → \rightarrow scene02).
A smaller number of transitions involve two simultaneous edits, e.g., scene02 → \rightarrow scene03, scene08 → \rightarrow scene09, scene16 → \rightarrow scene17, and scene18 → \rightarrow scene19.
Importantly, all edits remain local and limited to shape, color, or material, so consecutive scenes stay highly similar despite representing different personalized concepts.
blocks.zh:
表A5列出了该基准(被注为CLEVR)一次即时化的实际场景到场景编辑.
该表使链条构造明确:从场景t t到场景t + 1 t+1的每次过渡均由单个对象上一两个局部属性编辑实现.
大多数过渡涉及单一修改,如将对象2的颜色从蓝色改为绿色(scene00 →\rightarrow scene01),或将对象3的材料从金属改为橡胶(scene01 →\rightarrow scene02).
较少的过渡涉及两个并发的编辑,例如: scene02 → 右旋相声03, scene08 → 右旋相声09, scene16 → 右旋相声17,和 scene18 → 右旋相声19.
重要的是,所有编辑都保持局部性,仅限于外形,颜色,或材料,因此相继的场景尽管代表了不同的个性化概念,但保持高度相近.

blocks.en: Table A5: Scene-to-scene attribute change in CLEVR-Default. Each row indicates an actual edit applied when moving from scene t t to scene t + 1 t+1 .
blocks.zh: 表A5: CLEVR-Default中的场景对场景属性变化. 每行表示从场景 t t 移动到场景 t + 1 t+1 时实际应用的编辑.

blocks.en: A.2 Difficulty-controlled CLEVR
blocks.zh: A.2 难以控制的CLEVR

blocks.en:
In addition to the chain-based benchmark used in the main paper, we further construct difficulty-controlled CLEVR variants to analyze the behavior of personalization methods under systematically varying scene complexity and inter-concept distance.
These additional benchmarks are parameterized by the base number of objects K ∈ { 4 , 5 , 6 } K\in\{4,5,6\} and by the hop size, which determines how far each derived scene is from its parent scene.
blocks.zh:
除了主要论文中使用的以链为主的基准外,我们还进一步构建了由难度控制的CLEVR变体来分析个人化方法在系统不同的场景复杂性和概念间距离下的行为.
这些额外的基准被参数化为:对象的基数 K {{ 4, 5, 6} K\in {4, 5,6}和hop大小,它决定了每个衍生出场景离其母场景有多远.

blocks.en:
We define an “edit unit” as either changing one attribute (shape, color, size, or material) of a single object, or adding/removing one object.
A 1-hop modification applies one such edit unit, whereas a 2-hop modification applies two edit units sequentially, possibly on the same object or on different objects.
Using this definition, we generate two families of concept sets.
blocks.zh:
我们把“编辑单位”定义为改变一个物体的一个属性(形状、颜色、大小或材料),或添加/删除一个物体。
1-hop修改应用一个这样的编辑单元,而2-hop修改则依次应用两个编辑单元,可能在同一对象或不同对象上.
使用这个定义,我们产生两个概念组的家族.

blocks.en: Figure A6: Performance comparison on difficulty-controlled CLEVR with different base scene complexities K K (1-hop).
blocks.zh: 图A6:不同基场复杂性K(1-hop)的难度控制CLEVR性能比较.

blocks.en: Figure A7: Performance comparison on difficulty-controlled CLEVR with different base scene complexities K K (2-hop).
blocks.zh: 图A7:不同基场复杂性K(2-hop)的难度控制CLEVR性能比较.

blocks.en:
For the 1-hop setting, we first sample a random root scene with K K objects.
We then generate four scenes by applying one 1-hop modification to the root.
From each of these four scenes, we further generate four additional scenes using another 1-hop modification.
After discarding the initial root scene, this yields a set of 20 scenes in total.
blocks.zh:
对于1-hop设置,我们首先用K K 对象随机取出一个根景.
然后我们通过对根部进行1-hop的修改来生成4个场景.
从这四个场景的每个场景中,我们进一步利用又一个1-hop的修改生成了四个额外的场景.
在丢弃了最初的"根"场景后,这总共产生了一组20个场景.

blocks.en:
For the 2-hop setting, we follow the same procedure, except that each expansion step uses a 2-hop modification instead of a 1-hop one.
Again, after removing the root scene, we obtain 20 scenes.
During generation, we explicitly remove duplicate scenes to avoid degenerate cycles or accidental returns to previously generated configurations.
blocks.zh:
对于2-hop设定,我们遵循相同的程序,只是每个扩展步骤使用2-hop修改而不是1-hop.
再次,在移除了"根"后,我们获得了20个场景.
在生成期间,我们明确去除重复的场景来避免退化的循环或意外地返回到之前产生的配置.

blocks.en:
Compared with the CLEVR benchmark in the main paper, these additional variants provide two explicit difficulty knobs.
First, increasing K K makes the scene more complex by increasing the number of objects.
Second, the hop size controls the separation between concepts: 1-hop concepts are more locally confusable, while 2-hop concepts are typically more separated in concept space.
This allows a more fine-grained analysis of how personalization methods behave as the task becomes either more cluttered or more subtle.
blocks.zh:
与正文中的CLEVR基准相比,这些附加的变体提供了两个明显的困难取出.
首先,增加K K通过增加物体数量使场景变得更加复杂.
其次,hop大小控制了概念之间的分离:1-hop概念更适合本地使用,而2-hop概念一般在概念空间中更相分离.
这使得能够对个性化方法的行为进行更细微的分析,因为任务变得更复杂或更微妙。

blocks.en: A.3 Experimental Results on Difficulty-controlled CLEVR
blocks.zh: A.3 难以控制的CLEVR实验结果

blocks.en:
Table 2 in the main paper and Fig. A7 - A7 summarize the results.
Several trends are consistent across all settings.
First, increasing K K consistently makes the task more difficult.
As the number of objects grows from 4 to 6, positive accuracy drops for all methods in both the 1-hop and 2-hop settings.
This confirms that larger scenes introduce more distractors and make fine-grained matching substantially harder.
blocks.zh:
主文和图中的表2. A7 - A7总结了结果.
各种环境的几种趋势是一致的。
第一,增加KK使任务更加困难。
随着对象数量从4个增长到6个,无论是在1-hop还是2-hop设置中,所有方法的正准确度都下降.
这证实了更大的场景引入了更多的分心器,使精细的相配更加困难.

blocks.en:
Second, the 1-hop setting is more challenging than the 2-hop setting, especially in terms of positive accuracy.
Although 2-hop involves more edits, the resulting concepts are generally farther apart and therefore less confusable than 1-hop concepts, which differ by only a single local change.
This effect is clearly visible for both R2P and the baseline, whose positive accuracy improves noticeably in the 2-hop setting.
blocks.zh:
第二,1-hop设定比2-hop设定更具挑战性,特别是在正准确性方面.
虽然2-hop涉及更多的编辑,但由此产生的概念一般相去更远,因此与1-hop概念相比,互不相通,仅因一个局部变化而不同.
这种效应对于R2P和基线都明显可见,在2-hop设定中,正准确性明显提高.

blocks.en:
Third, ReCoG consistently achieves the best performance across all values of K K and under both hop settings.
The advantage is particularly large in the more confusable 1-hop regime.
For example, at K = 6 K=6 , ReCoG achieves 74.4% positive accuracy in the 1-hop setting, compared with 46.6% for R2P and 30.0% for the baseline.
Even in the 2-hop setting, where concepts are relatively easier to separate, ReCoG still maintains a clear margin, reaching 81.4% at K = 6 K=6 , compared with 68.4% and 40.0% for R2P and the baseline, respectively.
blocks.zh:
第三,ReCoG在KK的所有值以及在两个hop设置下都一致实现最佳性能.
在更相容的1-hop制度中,优势特别大.
例如,在 K = 6 K = 6 时, ReCoG 实现 74.4%的1-跳式设定为正准确度,而R2P为46.6%,基线为30.0%。
即使在2-hop设置中,概念比较容易分离,ReCoG仍然保持了明显的比值,在K=6K=6时达到81.4%,而R2P和基线分别是68.4%和40.0%.

blocks.en:
Finally, ReCoG shows notably stronger robustness as scene complexity increases from K = 5 K=5 to K = 6 K=6 .
In both the 1-hop and 2-hop settings, its positive accuracy drops only marginally, whereas the competing methods suffer substantially larger degradations.
For example, in the 1-hop setting ReCoG decreases from 76.6% to 74.4%, while R2P drops from 53.8% to 46.6% and the baseline from 36.1% to 30.0%.
Likewise, in the 2-hop setting ReCoG remains nearly unchanged (82.2% to 81.4%), in contrast to the larger declines of R2P (72.2% to 68.4%) and the baseline (50.5% to 40.0%).
This suggests that ReCoG scales more gracefully to more cluttered scenes and preserves its discriminative ability even in harder personalization regimes.
blocks.zh:
最后,随着场景复杂性从K=5K=5到K=6K=6的提高,ReCoG表现出显著的更强的稳健性.
在1-hop和2-hop两种设置中,其正准确度都只是略微下降,而相竞方法则遭受了更大规模的退化。
例如,在1-跳设置中,ReCoG从76.6%下降到74.4%,而R2P从53.8%下降到46.6%,基线从36.1%下降到30.0%.
同样,在双跳设置中,ReCoG几乎保持不变(82.2%至81.4%),而R2P(72.2%至68.4%)和基线(50.5%至40.0%)下降幅度较大。
这表明,ReCoG更优雅地对更杂乱的场景进行平整,即使在更严格的个性化制度下也保持了自己的歧视能力.

blocks.en: A.4 CLEVR with Changing Positional Arrangement
blocks.zh: A.4. 具有改变位置安排的CLEVR

blocks.en:
We additionally consider a harder CLEVR setting in which the main source of variation is positional arrangement.
Concretely, we begin with the four scenes generated by a 1-hop modification and, for each of them, create four additional 1-hop variants.
In this second stage, the modification is restricted to changes in the xy positions of objects, rather than their attributes or identities.
This setup makes the task significantly more difficult, because candidate scenes remain almost identical in object composition and differ mainly in spatial layout.
blocks.zh:
我们进一步考虑更严格的CLEVR设置,其中主要的变异来源是位置安排.
具体地说,我们从1-hop修改产生的4个场景开始,对于每个场景,我们再创造出4个1-hop的变体.
在第二阶段,修改仅限于物体的xy位置的变化,而不是其属性或身份.
这种设置使任务明显地更困难,因为候选场景在物体组成上仍然几乎完全相同,主要在空间布局上有所不同.

blocks.en:
As expected, Table A6 shows that the overall performance degrades under this setting, indicating that positional rearrangement is a particularly challenging factor for training-free personalization.
Nevertheless, ReCoG still consistently and substantially outperforms both the baseline and R2P, showing that explicit comparison remains effective even in this harder regime.
These results suggest that, while purely spatial changes without strong attribute differences are still difficult to resolve reliably, our relation-aware retrieval strategy provides a clear advantage over relation-agnostic alternatives.
blocks.zh:
如所料,表A6显示,在这一背景下,总体业绩下降,表明职位重新安排是无培训个人化的一个特别有挑战性的因素。
尽管如此,ReCoG仍然一贯和大大地超过了基线和R2P,表明即使在这种更困难的制度下,明确比较仍然有效。
这些结果表明,虽然没有强烈属性差异的纯粹空间变化仍然难以可靠地解决,但我们的亲和感检索战略提供了明显优势,比亲和可知的替代方法更为有利。

blocks.en: Table A6: Performance comparison for experiments on changing positional arrangement. Values are reported in Positive Accuracy/Negative Accuracy (%).
blocks.zh: 表A6:改变位置安排实验的性能比较。 数值以正准确度/负准确度(%)报告。

blocks.en: Table A7: Comparative results on CUB-Hard: MiniCPM-o-2.6 vs. LLaVA-1.5. Bold indicates the best performance within each model group.
blocks.zh: 表A7:CUB-Hard的比较结果:MiniCPM-o-2.6对LLaVA-1.5。 粗体表示每个模型组内的最佳表现.

blocks.en: Appendix B Construction and Variance of CUB-Hard
blocks.zh: 附录B 建筑和差异

blocks.en: CUB contains 200 birds and 312 class-level visual attributes. Among these attributes, we identified 16 attributes corresponding to black coloration in different body regions, such as wing or upperparts. For each species, we computed the mean score across these 16 attributes and ranked all 200 species. CUB-Hard consists of the 20 species with the highest scores. The support/query images were randomly selected.
blocks.zh: CUB包含200个鸟类和312个类级视觉属性. 在这些属性中,我们识别出16个对应不同身体区域的黑色色相的属性,如翅膀或上部. 对于每个物种,我们计算了这16个属性的平均分,并排名了所有200个物种。 CUB-Hard由得分最高的20个物种组成. 支持/平滑图像是随机选择的 。

blocks.en: To analyze the variance of CUB-Hard, we constructed three alternative concept sets using the same procedure. Specifically, we selected white, brown, and grey coloration, respectively. ReCoG consistently outperforms R2P with low variation across concept sets (see Table A8 ).
blocks.zh: 为了分析CUB-Hard的差异,我们用同样的程序构建了三套替代概念. 具体地说,我们分别选择了白色,褐色和灰色的颜色. ReCoG的绩效始终高于R2P,各概念组的差异不大(见表A8)。

blocks.en: Table A8: Performance comparison across different concept sets based on coloration.
blocks.zh: 表A8:基于颜色的不同概念集的性能比较.

blocks.en: Appendix C Impact of Employed VLMs
blocks.zh: 附录C 就业自愿工序的影响

blocks.en:
To examine whether the effectiveness of ReCoG depends on a specific VLM backbone, we additionally replace the recognition model used in the main paper (MiniCPM-o-2.6) with LLaVA-1.5 and evaluate on CUB-Hard.
Table A7 shows that ReCoG consistently outperforms the baseline under both backbones.
With MiniCPM-o-2.6, ReCoG improves the weighted accuracy from 69.4 to 92.8.
The same trend is preserved with LLaVA-1.5, where ReCoG improves the weighted accuracy from 66.4 to 94.5.
A similar pattern is observed for positive accuracy: under LLaVA-1.5, ReCoG achieves 89.4, substantially higher than the baseline score of 36.1.
These results indicate that the gain from ReCoG does not rely on a particular VLM choice.
Even when the recognition backbone is replaced, incorporating relation-aware concept retrieval consistently provides large improvements over the relation-agnostic baseline.
This suggests that ReCoG is a general and backbone-compatible personalization framework.
blocks.zh:
为了审查ReCoG的有效性是否取决于特定的VLM主干线,我们额外地将主论文(MiniCPM-o-2.6)中使用的识别模型替换为LLaVA-1.5并评价CUB-Hard.
表A7显示,ReCoG的业绩始终高于两个主干下的基准。
通过MiniCPM-o-2.6,ReCoG将加权精度从69.4提高到92.8.
LLaVA-1.5保持了同样的趋势,ReCoG将加权精度从66.4提高到94.5.
在正准确性方面观察到了类似的模式:在LLaVA-1.5下,ReCoG的成绩为89.4分,大大高于基线分数36.1分.
这些结果表明,ReCoG的收益并不依赖于特定的VLM选择.
即使更换了识别主干线,纳入了解关系的概念检索也始终比了解关系基线大有改进。
这表明ReCoG是一个总的和骨干相容的个性化框架.

blocks.en: Appendix D Details on VLM Prompting
blocks.zh: 附录D VLM 提示的细节

blocks.en: D.1 Prompt Template for Relation-aware Database Construction
blocks.zh: D.1 建立了解关系数据库的快速模板

blocks.en:
In this section, we provide the prompt used for database construction ( P disc P_{\mathrm{disc}} in Sec. 4.2).
Figure A8 shows the template for eliciting discriminative concept features from a frozen VLM.
blocks.zh:
在本节中,我们提供了用于数据库构建的快取(P disc. disc. at Sec. 4.2)。
图A8显示了从被冻结的VLM中获取歧视性概念特征的模板。

blocks.en: Compare the two {category} concepts identified by the concept-identifiers and highlight what makes each concept unique.
blocks.zh: 比较概念识别符确定的两个{类别}概念,并突出每个概念的独特性。

blocks.en: - Image 1: < < example1 > > - Image 2: < < example2 > >

Your response MUST follow EXACTLY the JSON format shown below (and nothing else): { "example1 distinct features": ["feat1", "feat2", "feat3"], "example2 distinct features": ["feat1", "feat2", "feat3"] }
blocks.zh: 您的反应必须完全遵循以下(和无其他)的JSON格式: {"例1"的特征: ["feat1","feat2","feat3"],"例2"的特征: ["feat1","feat2","feat3"] {\fn黑体\fs22\bord1\shad0\3aHBE\4aH00\fscx67\fscy66\2cHFFFFFF\3cH808080}你觉得呢?

blocks.en: IMPORTANT: - Do not include any additional text or commentary. - Any deviation from this format will be considered incorrect.
blocks.zh: 重要: - 不包括任何补充案文或评注。 - 任何偏离这一格式的做法都将被认为是不正确的。

blocks.en: Figure A8: Prompt template for relation-aware database construction.
blocks.zh: 图A8:了解关系数据库构建的快速模板.

blocks.en:
Given two support images corresponding to a pair of concepts, the prompt asks the VLM to explicitly compare them and identify what makes each concept distinct from the other.
Unlike generic captioning or independent concept description, this prompt is designed to produce relational and contrastive evidence, i.e., features that are useful specifically for distinguishing one concept from a visually similar alternative.
This pairwise comparison is the key ingredient for constructing the directed edges in our relational concept graph.
blocks.zh:
鉴于两个对应一对概念的支持图像,提示符要求VLM明确比较它们,并找出使每个概念与另一个概念不同的原因.
与一般标题或独立的概念描述不同,这个提示设计是为了产生关系和对比性的证据,即专门用来区分一个概念和视觉相近的替代物的特征.
这种对等比较是构建我们关系概念图中定向边缘的关键成分.

blocks.en:
To ensure that the VLM output can be parsed and stored reliably, we enforce a strict JSON-only response format.
For each ordered concept pair, the model returns two lists of distinct features, one for each concept from its own perspective.
These textual outputs are then used as the discriminative edge evidence.
By repeating this process over concept pairs, we obtain a database that captures not only per-concept visual representations, but also explicit inter-concept differences that are directly useful for fine-grained personalized recognition.
blocks.zh:
为了保证VLM输出能够被解析和可靠地存储,我们执行严格的JSON唯一的响应格式.
对于每个被订购的概念配对,模型会返回两个不同特征的清单,一个从自己的角度对每个概念.
这些文字输出随后被作为歧视边缘证据.
通过重复这个过程而不是概念对等,我们得到了一个数据库,它不仅能够捕捉到每个概念的视觉表现,而且能够捕捉到对精细的个性化识别直接有用的明确的概念间差异.

blocks.en: D.2 Prompt Template for Comparison-based Retrieval
blocks.zh: D.2 基于比较检索的快速模板

blocks.en: You are a helpful AI agent specializing in image analysis and object recognition. You are given three images: - Image 1: Query image (the image to classify) - Image 2: Reference image for concept “{concept1_name}” - Image 3: Reference image for concept “{concept2_name}”
blocks.zh: 你是一个有帮助的AI代理 专门进行图像分析和对象识别。 给你们三个图像: - 图像1:查询图像(要分类的图像) - 图像2: 概念“{概念1_名称}”的参考图像 - 图3:“{概念2_名称}”的参考图像

blocks.en: Additionally, you are provided with information about these two concepts: Distinctive features of {concept1_name}: ["feat1", "feat2", "feat3"] Distinctive features of {concept2_name}: ["feat1", "feat2", "feat3"]
blocks.zh: 此外,还向你们提供有关这两个概念的信息: {Concept1_name}的区别特征: ["feat1","feat2","feat3"]. {cept2_name}的区别特征: ["feat1","feat2","feat3"].

blocks.en: Task: - Compare Image 1 (query) with Image 2 and Image 3. - Determine which concept the query image belongs to. - Focus on the distinctive features provided above to make your decision.
blocks.zh: 任务: - 将图像 1 (query) 与图像 2 和图像对比 3. 确定查询图像属于哪个概念。

blocks.en: Question: - Provide your reasoning based on the distinctive features. - Generate your response in JSON format: {"Reasoning": "...", "Answer": "..."} - Output only the JSON response. DO NOT output any additional text.
blocks.zh: 问题: - 提供您基于不同特征的推理。 - 用JSON格式生成您的响应: {"Reasoning":".","Answer":"."} - 只输出JSON的响应. 不要输出任何额外文本 。

blocks.en: Figure A9: Prompt template for comparison-based retrieval.
blocks.zh: 图A9:用于比较检索的快速模板.

blocks.en: In this section, we provide the prompt used for discriminative retrieval via explicit comparison ( P comp P_{\mathrm{comp}} in Sec. 4.3). Figure A9 shows the template used at inference time for comparison-based retrieval.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们提供了通过明确比较进行歧视性检索所用的快捷(第4.3节中的Pcomp P_{\-mathrm{comp}})。 图A9显示了推断时用于比较检索的模板.

blocks.en:
Given a query image and two candidate support images, the prompt asks a frozen VLM to determine which candidate concept is more compatible with the query.
Importantly, the model is not asked to make this decision based only on global visual similarity.
Instead, it is additionally provided with the concept-specific distinctive features extracted during database construction, so that the comparison can focus on the most discriminative evidence between the two candidates.
This design directly reflects the retrieval procedure of ReCoG.
After CLIP-based pruning produces a small candidate set, fine-grained ambiguity remains among visually similar concepts.
This prompt resolves such ambiguity by forcing the VLM to compare two candidates side by side while conditioning on their relation-aware textual evidence.
In this way, retrieval is performed through relative judgment rather than independent scoring of each concept.
blocks.zh:
考虑到一个查询图像和两个候选支持图像,提示请求一个被冻结的VLM来确定哪个候选概念更能与查询兼容.
重要的是,并不要求该模型仅仅根据全球视觉相似性作出这一决定。
相反,它还提供了数据库构建过程中提取的针对具体概念的独特特征,以便比较可以侧重于两个候选人之间最有歧视性的证据。
这个设计直接反映了ReCoG的检索程序.
在基于CLIP的打压产生一个小的候选集后,在视觉相近的概念中仍然存在着细微的模糊.
这样一来,就解决了这种含糊不清的问题,迫使核查组一边比较两个候选人,一边以他们了解关系的证据为条件。
这样,检索是通过相对判断进行的,而不是通过对每个概念的独立评分。

blocks.en: For each comparison, the model returns a short reasoning trace together with its final choice. These pairwise decisions are then aggregated across all candidate pairs, as described in Sec. 4.3, to determine the final prediction.
blocks.zh: 对于每个比较,模型会返回一个简短的推理追踪,连同其最终选择. 如第4.3节所描述的,这些对等决定随后被汇总到所有候选对等决定中,以确定最终预测。

blocks.en: Appendix E Validation on Realistic Open-Domain Personalized Concepts
blocks.zh: 附录 E 关于现实开放域个性化概念的验证

blocks.en: To further validate ReCoG, we additionally conducted an experiment on CelebA. We treated each identity ID as a personalized concept. For each concept, we used one support image and 19 query images. We constructed all 190 pairwise relational edges among the 20 concepts. Under support-image seed 42, ReCoG improves P.Acc. from 76.1% to 94.2% (see Table A9 ). This result provides additional evidence that ReCoG is effective not only for birds or synthetic scenes, but also for fine-grained recognition of real human identities.
blocks.zh: 为了进一步验证ReCoG,我们还对CelebA进行了一次实验. 我们把每个身份证都当作个性化的概念 对于每个概念,我们使用一个支持图像和19个查询图像。 我们在20个概念中构建了所有190个对等关系边缘。 在支持图像种子42下,ReCoG将P.Acc从76.1%提高到94.2%(见表A9)。 这一结果提供了更多的证据,证明ReCoG不仅对鸟类或合成场景有效,而且对精细地识别出真实的人类身份也有效.

blocks.en: Table A9: Personalized recognition performance on CelebA.
blocks.zh: 表A9 CelebA上的个性化识别表现.

blocks.en: Appendix F Sensitivity to the Selected Support Image
blocks.zh: 选定支持图像的敏感性

blocks.en: The method may be sensitive to the chosen support image. Since relational edges are generated from a single support image per concept, the extracted cues may reflect image-specific artifacts rather than stable concept-level differences. To address this issue, we resampled the support image for every concept using five different random seeds and reconstructed the corresponding concept databases. All other evaluation settings (CUB-Hard) were kept unchanged. ReCoG outperforms R2P under every support-image selection (see Table A10 ). Although the absolute performance of ReCoG varies across exemplars, its advantage remains consistent. Moreover, we find that the performance variance of ReCoG is even smaller than that of R2P. These results demonstrate that the gain is not tied to one particular set of support images.
blocks.zh: 该方法可能对所选支持图像敏感. 由于关系边由每个概念的单个支持图像产生,所提取的提示可能反映图像特定文物,而不是稳定的概念级差异. 为了解决这个问题,我们用五个不同的随机种子重新模拟了每个概念的支持图像并重建了相应的概念数据库. 所有其他评价设置(CUB-Hard)保持不变。 ReCoG在每个支持图像选择下都超越了R2P(见表A10. 尽管ReCoG的绝对性能因实例而异,但其优势依然一致. 此外,我们发现,ReCoG的性能差异甚至小于R2P. 这些结果表明,收益并非与某一组支持图像相挂钩。

blocks.en: Table A10: Sensitivity to support image selection under different random seeds.
blocks.zh: 表A10:在不同随机种子下支持图像选择的敏感性.

blocks.en: Appendix G Qualitative Results
blocks.zh: 附录G 定性 结果

blocks.en: Figure A10 in the next page illustrates why explicit comparison is important in fine-grained personalization. For reference, the answer is Yes .
blocks.zh: 下页图A10说明了为什么明确比较在精细的个性化中很重要. 供参考,答案是 " 是 " 。

blocks.en:
In the relation-agnostic pipeline (top), the model reasons from independently described concept features and therefore tends to focus on salient attributes that are visible in the query, such as the small red cube, and the large purple metallic cylinder.
However, many of these cues are not truly discriminative because they are also compatible with competing concepts ( hex and nba ).
As a result, the prediction is driven by generic overlap rather than by the critical differences among candidates, ultimately leading to the wrong answer: nba .
blocks.zh:
在关系不可知管(top)中,模型来自独立描述的概念特征,因此倾向于注重在查询中可见的显著属性,如小红色立方体和大紫色金属圆柱.
然而,其中许多提示并非真正具有歧视性,因为它们也与相竞的概念相兼容(hex和nba.).
因此,预测是由通用重叠而不是候选人之间的关键差异所驱动的,最终导致错误的答案:nba.

blocks.en:
In contrast, ReCoG (bottom) explicitly compares candidates using relation-aware evidence stored between concept pairs.
This makes the model attend to how one candidate differs from another, rather than simply checking whether a candidate has some visible attributes.
For example, the comparison highlights subtle yet distinguishing cues such as "The green sphere has been replaced" (vs. nba ) or "Purple cylinder has been added" (vs. hex ).
These separate kie from the other retrieved concepts.
By grounding the decision on these inter-concept differences, ReCoG correctly resolves the ambiguity and predicts kie .
blocks.zh:
相比之下,ReCoG(从下到下)则使用概念对之间存储的具有关联性的证据对候选人进行明确比较.
这使得模型关注一个候选人与另一个候选人的区别,而不是简单地检查一个候选人是否有一些明显的属性.
例如,比较突出了微妙而有区别的提示,如"绿色球场被替换"(vs. nba.)或"紫外圆柱被添加"(vs. hex.)等.
这些将Kie与其他检索到的概念分开。
ReCoG通过将这些概念间分歧作为决定的依据,正确解决了模糊性,并预测了kie.

blocks.en: In addition, Fig. A11 compares the captioning results of R2P and ReCoG.
blocks.zh: 此外,Fig. A11比较了R2P和ReCoG的字幕结果.

blocks.en: Figure A10: Qualitative example comparing R2P-style retrieval (top) and ReCoG (bottom). The query belongs to kie . While the relation-agnostic method is misled by prominent shared attributes and incorrectly favors nba , ReCoG resolves the ambiguity through explicit pairwise comparison with relation-aware evidence and correctly predicts kie .
blocks.zh: 图A10:比较R2P风格检索(上)和ReCoG(下)的定性实例. 该查询属于 Kie 。 尽管关系不可知性方法被显著的共享属性所误导,并错误地偏好nba , ReCoG通过与关系知觉证据的明确的对等比较来解决模糊性,并正确预测kie .
